## Change

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and any related issue. Link the
relevant design or roadmap phase for changes to synchronization or launchers.

## Validation

List the commands or manual checks performed and their results. For documentation
changes, check links and examples. State anything not tested and why. Include
screenshots for visible changes when useful, with private information removed.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I followed [the contribution guide](https://github.com/enderliker/NeoSync/blob/1.21.1/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md) and preserved applicable licenses and attribution.
- [ ] I updated affected documentation and distinguished implemented behavior from plans.
- [ ] I considered consent, source restrictions, credentials, and profile preservation where relevant.
- [ ] I excluded generated Minecraft files, test installations, third-party mods, and secrets.

For a sensitive vulnerability, use [the private reporting channel](https://github.com/enderliker/NeoSync/blob/1.21.1/SECURITY.md) before opening a public pull request.
